name: 219. Vertex key credential changes need a genuine credential check (key-credential-dial-targets) [SERIAL]
description: Management-plane regression for the default harness profile (tests/integrations/python/config.json: dashboard auth unconfigured, setup lock active with a configured setup token). A Vertex key whose auth_credentials JSON is an external-account document names its own token_url and a credential_source file: the Google client would read that file and post it to that host on the key's first use. Under this profile no request reaches the provider-key handler without a credential check: a request without the setup token is refused at the setup lock with 401 and nothing is saved, and a request carrying the setup token passed a credential check, so it may set the credential JSON. The handler's own 403 for a request admitted without any check (auth bypassed or a whitelisted route) cannot be reached from this profile; it is pinned by TestProviderKeyEndpointGuard_CoversEveryDialTarget in provider_keys_test.go. Key names carry a per-run id so an earlier run's leftovers never fail this one, and the admitted key is created disabled and scoped to an unused model so no other request can select it before it is deleted.
